subject: math
description: Solve navigation and rescue-route bearing problems by drawing oblique triangles and choosing the Law of Sines or Law of Cosines.
learningObjectives: Interpret three-digit bearings as clockwise angles measured from north
Draw and label a bearing diagram from a two-leg travel scenario
Identify when a bearing problem creates SAS, ASA, AAS, or SSA information
Use the Law of Cosines to find a missing distance when two legs and the included angle are known
Use the Law of Sines to find a missing direction or bearing after a distance is known
State final answers with units and practical navigation meaning
prerequisites: Calculator use with sine, cosine, inverse sine, and inverse cosine
